title: Run Zizmor on `ubuntu-slim`
body:
https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action ≥ 0.7.0 supports (and documents/recommends) running on `ubuntu-slim` instead of `ubuntu-latest`, and supposedly it is more efficient / cheaper (although the cost part might not be relevant to us) per https://github.blog/changelog/2025-10-28-1-vcpu-linux-runner-now-available-in-github-actions-in-public-preview/ .

So I suppose we could migrate, in all our repos. Cc: @alegrey91 whenever you have time.
